records.title: QR-DETR: Query Routing for Detection Transformer
records.reason: QR-DETR routes object queries through selected detection-transformer decoder layers, allowing other queries to exit early and preventing indiscriminate communication; the publisher abstract evaluates COCO detection mAP, without a concrete LLM inference connection.

records.title: Estimating transfer entropy under long ranged dependencies
records.reason: The primary abstract concerns estimating transfer entropy in time series for finance and neuroscience using conditional likelihoods and locality-sensitive-hash perturbations; it does not connect this estimator to LLM inference/system efficiency.

records.title: Near-Linear Scaling Data Parallel Training with Overlapping-Aware Gradient Compression
records.reason: The abstract presents COVAP as gradient compression and communication-computation overlap for DNN data-parallel training; the improvement is training time/scaling, with no inference, serving, or deployment mechanism for LLM systems.

records.title: A transformer-based model for next disease prediction using electronic health records
records.reason: The publisher abstract pretrains an encoder on electronic health records and fine-tunes encoder-decoder disease prediction, comparing diagnostic precision/recall; no LLM inference-system efficiency mechanism is established.

records.title: ChatGPT y GPT-4: utilidades en el sector jurídico, funcionamiento, limitaciones y riesgos  de los modelos fundacionales
records.reason: The primary Spanish abstract analyzes ChatGPT/GPT-4 legal-sector functionality, limitations and legal risks; it provides no LLM inference execution optimization.

records.title: Aurora-M: Open Source Continual Pre-training for Multilingual Language and Code
records.reason: The primary arXiv record has a different title from the packet title and describes open model pretraining, multilingual performance, and red-teaming; it contributes no inference efficiency or serving mechanism.

records.title: Assessing awareness of environmental sustainability in machine learning research
records.reason: The publisher abstract surveys sustainability awareness in over 1,100 ML-conference papers using resource/carbon-reporting categories; it assesses research practices and guidelines rather than proposing or benchmarking an LLM inference efficiency mechanism.

records.title: OpenGCRAM: An Open-Source Gain Cell Compiler Enabling Design-Space Exploration for AI Workloads

records.title: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Transformers for Efficient Scaling of Large Language Models

records.title: Empowering Long-form Omni-modal Understanding with Robust Audio Perception
records.reason: AVDC decouples audio/visual captions and AVDC-QA-CoT supplies reasoning supervision; its two-stage model training improves omni-modal perception benchmarks without an inference execution efficiency mechanism.

records.title: OPOD: On-Policy Omni Distillation
records.reason: OPOD consolidates text, image and audio teachers through modality-routed on-policy distillation and one-sided token guidance; section 3.2 explicitly discards the teachers for deployment, retaining a single student without teacher-ensemble latency or memory.

records.title: Thinking Hard, Not Smart: Reasoning Models Fail to Ration Test-Time Compute Across Questions
records.reason: The exam-style benchmark evaluates allocation of one shared inference-token budget across questions under end-to-end cost/latency constraints, exposing presentation-order and front-loading failures directly relevant to test-time compute scheduling.
